card.name: Linking words in credit and finance text
card.fires_on: Commas, small linking words and pronouns (such as 'and', 'with', 'upon', 'your') inside web text about credit, lending, assets and property. It fires on the word just before a finance term is expected.

modes.label: Commas in lists
modes.description: A comma between items in a list of factors a lender weighs, such as income and time at an address.
modes.example: They may consider your income<<,>> how long you’ve lived at your present

modes.label: Linking words before finance nouns
modes.description: Short words like 'and', 'with', 'upon' or 'your' that come right before words such as assets, agreements or credit information.
modes.example: all property<< and>> assets owned by a deceased person or (
